metrics.name: Snapshot aggregate deltas
metrics.decision: Determine whether repository-scale graph inventory, violation, provider, bypass, or debt totals changed from the selected prior snapshot.
metrics.definition: The signed current-minus-prior deltas persisted in the single current snapshot regression-summary row.
metrics.formula: current aggregate minus the same aggregate from the immediately preceding available Phase D baseline
metrics.population: All canonical nodes, edges, violations, eligible cross-layer imports and calls, provider invocations, non-UWG write paths, and Phase C debt rows in the current snapshot.
exclusions: Rows excluded by the authoritative upstream materialized-view definitions.
metrics.normalization: None; consumers must pair raw deltas with current and prior denominators.
metrics.confidence_derivation: Exact for the selected prior snapshot when comparison_status is EXACT; unknown when comparison_status is NO_BASELINE.
metrics.baseline_strategy: The prior in-file Phase D baseline, otherwise the newest readable prior adg_indexed SQLite artifact.
metrics.threshold_strategy: Diagnostic only until certified-snapshot selection and normalized thresholds are implemented.
metrics.severity_mapping: No automatic severity; downstream policy must evaluate each decomposed delta independently.
limitations: The incremental implementation selects prior artifacts by modification time, not certification state.
Raw aggregate deltas do not identify which stable rows changed.
metrics.evidence_query: SELECT * FROM mv_snapshot_regression_summary ORDER BY snapshot_id
metrics.validation: First run has zero deltas and NO_BASELINE; identical consecutive materializations have zero deltas and EXACT.
metrics.remediation: Drill into the corresponding row-level Phase D metric before changing code or a baseline.

metrics.name: New critical-path memberships
metrics.decision: Identify modules that newly crossed into the configured critical-path population.
metrics.definition: Count of current critical-path rows whose stable module key was absent from an available prior snapshot.
metrics.population: Current module rows with criticality_score greater than 5.0.
exclusions: Rows at or below the Phase D criticality threshold.
metrics.normalization: Report count and current critical-path population; do not interpret the raw count as repository health alone.
metrics.confidence_derivation: 1.0 for exact stable-key membership comparison; unknown without a prior baseline.
metrics.baseline_strategy: Compare adg_name plus resolved file path to the immediately preceding available Phase D population.
metrics.threshold_strategy: Diagnostic; rank by score and score delta until an approved certified baseline exists.
metrics.severity_mapping: Severity is inherited from the affected layer and downstream decision contract, not from is_new alone.
limitations: A module rename or move creates a new stable key in this pre-schema-v5 implementation.
metrics.evidence_query: SELECT adg_name, file, layer, criticality_score, prev_score, delta FROM mv_newly_introduced_critical_paths WHERE is_new = 1 ORDER BY criticality_score DESC, adg_name
metrics.validation: Identical consecutive populations yield zero new rows; adding one stable module key yields exactly one new row.
metrics.remediation: Inspect fan-in, fan-out, violations, changed files, and impacted tests for each newly critical module.

metrics.name: New cross-layer dependency groups
metrics.decision: Identify newly present directed layer-to-layer relation groups and distinguish them from growth inside an existing group.
metrics.definition: Count of current directed source-layer, destination-layer, and relation-type groups absent from an available prior snapshot.
metrics.formula: COUNT(*) WHERE is_new = 1; edge_delta is current group edge_count minus prior group edge_count
metrics.population: Non-test cross-layer imports, calls, and violates relations with non-empty source and destination layers.
exclusions: Relations other than imports, calls, and violates.
metrics.normalization: Report group membership separately from within-group edge_delta.
metrics.confidence_derivation: 1.0 for exact stable group-key comparison; unknown without a prior baseline.
metrics.baseline_strategy: Compare the directed layer-pair and relation-type key to the immediately preceding available Phase D population.
metrics.threshold_strategy: Use versioned layer policy for severity; do not classify a group as harmful solely because it is new.
metrics.severity_mapping: Illegal policy transitions inherit policy severity; otherwise diagnostic.
limitations: The table is grouped by layers and relation type, not by individual stable edge key.
metrics.evidence_query: SELECT src_layer, dst_layer, relation_type, edge_count, prev_edge_count, edge_delta FROM mv_new_cross_layer_dependencies WHERE is_new = 1 ORDER BY edge_count DESC, src_layer, dst_layer, relation_type
metrics.validation: Growth in an existing group leaves is_new at zero and changes edge_delta; a new group key yields exactly one new row.
metrics.remediation: Inspect the underlying edges and either route through an approved boundary or document the sanctioned dependency.

metrics.name: New provider surfaces
metrics.decision: Identify production caller-to-provider surfaces that appeared since the selected prior snapshot.
metrics.definition: Count of current caller file, caller layer, provider name, and provider path groups absent from an available prior snapshot.
metrics.formula: COUNT(*) WHERE is_new = 1; invocation_delta is current invocation_count minus prior invocation_count
metrics.population: Non-test and non-tools invokes_provider relations grouped by caller and provider surface.
metrics.normalization: Report new surface count with the total current provider-surface population.
metrics.confidence_derivation: 1.0 for exact stable surface-key comparison; unknown without a prior baseline.
metrics.baseline_strategy: Compare the caller/provider surface key to the immediately preceding available Phase D population.
metrics.threshold_strategy: Diagnostic until provider policy maps approved and unapproved surfaces.
metrics.severity_mapping: Provider-policy violations inherit policy severity; approved new surfaces remain informational.
limitations: Caller or provider renames and moves create new keys before schema-v5 stable identities exist.
metrics.evidence_query: SELECT caller_file, caller_layer, provider_name, provider_path, invocation_count, prev_invocation_count, invocation_delta FROM mv_new_provider_surfaces WHERE is_new = 1 ORDER BY invocation_count DESC, caller_file, provider_name
metrics.validation: Identical consecutive surfaces yield zero new rows; replacing a surface at constant aggregate count still yields the replacement as new.
metrics.remediation: Verify routing, credentials, egress controls, observability, caching, and approved-provider policy for each new surface.

metrics.name: New write-bypass paths
metrics.decision: Identify a non-UWG durable-write call site that was not present in the selected prior snapshot.
metrics.definition: Count of current non-UWG write rows whose stable source-location key was absent from an available prior snapshot.
metrics.population: Current Phase A write-sovereignty rows where is_uwg_routed equals zero.
exclusions: Writes excluded by the authoritative Phase A write-sovereignty contract.
metrics.normalization: No composite normalization; every new bypass retains its own evidence and severity.
metrics.confidence_derivation: 1.0 when comparison_status is EXACT; conservative legacy match when LEGACY_COARSE; unknown when NO_BASELINE.
metrics.baseline_strategy: Compare writer file, layer, symbol, line, and source file to the immediately preceding available Phase D population.
metrics.threshold_strategy: Any exact new bypass is eligible for the existing P0 write-sovereignty policy; NO_BASELINE must not be treated as pass or new.
metrics.severity_mapping: Use the Phase A severity and direct-infrastructure classification without overriding them from aggregate count changes.
limitations: One upgrade cycle may use LEGACY_COARSE matching because the previous Phase D schema omitted source location.
The pre-schema-v5 key changes when a call site moves to another line.
metrics.evidence_query: SELECT edge_id, writer_file, writer_layer, write_symbol, write_line, source_file, severity, is_direct_infra_write FROM mv_new_write_bypass_paths WHERE is_new = 1 ORDER BY severity, writer_file, write_line, write_symbol
metrics.validation: An unchanged critical bypass is not new; replacing one bypass with another at constant aggregate count identifies only the replacement as new.
metrics.remediation: Route the write through UWG or correct an upstream scanner false positive with exact evidence.
